The Dietetic Students’ Association (DiETS), in collaboration with the student associations of the Faculty of Health Sciences, Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM), Puncak Alam Campus, is pleased to invite Prof./Assoc.

Prof./Dr./Mr./Mrs./Ms./Sir to participate in the International Innovation, Invention and Creation Exhibition (IIICE) 2026.

IIICE 2026 is an international virtual innovation and invention competition that provides a platform for students, educators, researchers, professionals, and members of the public to showcase innovative ideas, inventions, creative solutions, and research-based products.
The exhibition aims to foster a culture of innovation, creativity, research translation, and knowledge exchange.
We warmly encourage individuals and teams from diverse academic and professional backgrounds to take advantage of this platform to showcase their innovations.
